name: Arsco Custom Metals LLC
old_description: Ligature-Resistant Products, Architectural HVAC Covers & Enclosures
about:
Arsco Custom Metals LLC operates from Cincinnati, Ohio, where it has been in business for nearly a century. The company describes itself as a full-service, one-stop shop for sheet metal fabrication — designing, building, and installing custom metal products. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in the source material, and ownership structure (family, veteran, woman-owned, etc.) is not stated.

The company provides end-to-end sheet metal fabrication, including stamping, injection molding, manual forming, automated panel bending, rolling, MIG/TIG and robotic welding, powder coating, pem inserting, punching, and product assembly. It also offers 3D design and engineering, on-site measuring, professional installation, and project management. Arsco produces both standard and custom products such as ligature-resistant HVAC enclosures, television and display enclosures, radiator covers, fan coil/PTAC/induction/radiant heat enclosures, convector and finned-tube enclosures, and sloped louver grilles. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Arsco serves healthcare and behavioral health facilities, education, transportation, hospitality, defense and aerospace, residential and commercial construction, and corrections. Its customer base ranges from small contract manufacturers to Fortune 500 firms across the U.S. and internationally, with the company noting that over 90% of its customers are repeat buyers.

Arsco emphasizes "intellectual intensity and attention to detail at every stage" as its differentiator, positioning itself as a single-source partner that handles design through installation. It highlights artisan craftsmanship merged with industrial precision, nationwide shipping with in-house packaging, and the ability to support both new construction and renovation projects with irregular field conditions.
